summary.text: Singpass updates do not change your CPF contact details. Update them through CPF’s Account settings.

details.heading: After you change your details
details.body: Changes to your contact details have a 12-hour cooling period. You may also need to go through enhanced authentication measures to verify your identity.

steps.name: Open Account settings
steps.text: Use your Singpass to open Account settings in my cpf digital services.

items: Use your Singpass to open Account settings in my cpf digital services.

steps.name: Verify and submit
steps.text: Enter the One-Time PIN sent to your new mobile number or email address. This verifies your contact detail before you submit the changes.

example_phrasings: I have updated my email address or mobile number with Singpass. Why has CPF not updated it?
Why did Singpass not update my CPF contact details?

sources.page_title: I have updated my email address/mobile number with Singpass. Why are my Singpass contact details not updated with CPF Board?

quotes.text: Updates to your Singpass mobile number and email address will not be automatically updated with the Board.
You can update your mobile number and/or email address via my cpf digital services – Account settings with your Singpass.
An SMS or email One-Time PIN (OTP) will be sent to your new mobile or email address for verification before the changes can be submitted.
Please note that any changes to your contact details will be subject to a 12-hour cooling period and you may be subject to enhanced authentication measures to verify your identity.
